findings.description: The second serializer rebuilds Content-Length from the already de-chunked body, so attempt 1 and attempt 2 agree on the length and the bytes; only Host differs. Chunk splitting inside the target does not destabilise the replay.
findings.title: A chunked GET replays its de-chunked body byte-identically on retry

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
